en.headline: Fifteen senior civil servants to begin year-long study at Peking University
en.dek: Secretary for the Civil Service Ingrid Yeung said the fifth cohort of the two-year Master of Public Administration programme will start immersive learning in Beijing next month.
body: Fifteen senior civil servants from the administrative, executive, professional and disciplined services grades will travel to Peking University next month for a year of immersive study under the fifth intake of a two-year Master of Public Administration programme jointly organised by the Civil Service Bureau and the university.

Secretary for the Civil Service Ingrid Yeung said the officers will deepen their understanding of national development strategies, the national governance system and public administration knowledge, while exchanging with mainland officials, academics and members of the public and conducting study visits to multiple provinces and cities.

She set three expectations for the cohort: to combine theory with practice, to grasp Hong Kong’s positioning and opportunities within national development while noting mainland public views on the city, and to actively expand networks of mutual trust and cooperation on the mainland.

More than 60 civil servants have been selected for the programme since 2022. The first three cohorts have graduated and the fourth has returned to work in Hong Kong while completing their dissertations.

zh.headline: 15名高級公務員下月赴北大展開一年沉浸式學習
zh.dek: 公務員事務局局長楊何蓓茵表示，第五屆高級公務員公共管理碩士課程學員將於九月在北京大學展開全年學習。
body: 15名來自政務、行政主任、專業及紀律部隊職系的高級公務員，將於下月前往北京大學，參與公務員事務局與北大合辦的兩年制高級公務員公共管理碩士課程第五屆，展開為期一年的沉浸式學習。
公務員事務局局長楊何蓓茵表示，學員在京期間將深入認識國家發展戰略、國家治理體系及公共管理專業知識，與內地官員、學者和民眾交流，並到多個省市考察調研。
她提出三點期望，包括用好學習機會做到理論與實踐結合、深入認識國家最新發展及留意內地民眾對香港的見解以把握香港在國家發展全局中的定位和機遇，以及主動拓展內地朋友圈建立互信合作關係。
自2022年起當局已選派超過60名具潛質的公務員參加此課程，首三屆學員均已順利畢業，第四屆學員亦已回港重投工作並完成論文。
